text_en: To the leader. A Psalm of David.
Deliver me, O Lord , from evildoers; protect me from those who are violent,
text_cn: 上主，求你救拔我脱离凶恶的人， 上主，求你保护我摆脱强暴的人！

text_en: who plan evil things in their minds and stir up wars continually.
text_cn: 他们心中策划恶谋， 他们终日挑拨争斗；

text_en: They make their tongue sharp as a snake’s, and under their lips is the venom of vipers. Selah
text_cn: 他们磨快自己的舌尖，有如蛇蝮， 在他们的双唇的下面，含有蛇毒。 （休止）

text_en: Guard me, O Lord , from the hands of the wicked; protect me from the violent who have planned my downfall.
text_cn: 上主，求你拯救我脱离凶恶的人， 上主，求你保护我摆脱强暴的人， 因他们企图要我脚步滑倒。

text_en: The arrogant have hidden a trap for me, and with cords they have spread a net, along the road they have set snares for me. Selah
text_cn: 骄傲人给我暗暗设下网罗， 张起绳索作为圈套， 设下陷阱等我路过。（休止）

text_en: I say to the Lord , “You are my God; give ear, O Lord , to the voice of my supplications. ”
text_cn: 我求上主说：你是我的天主； 上主，求你听我哀祷的苦诉！

text_en: O Lord , my Lord, my strong deliverer, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
text_cn: 上主天主，你是我有力的救助， 在作战时，请你掩护我的头颅！

text_en: Do not grant, O Lord , the desires of the wicked; do not further their evil plot. Selah
text_cn: 上主，请不要顺随恶人的奢欲， 上主，请不要完成他们的计谋。 （休止）

text_en: Those who surround me lift up their heads; let the mischief of their lips overwhelm them!
text_cn: 愿那些显露头角而围困我的人， 出于他们口唇的诅咒，反归己身。

text_en: Let burning coals fall on them! Let them be flung into pits, no more to rise!
text_cn: 愿火炭降落在他们的身上， 将他们抛入深坑免再高昂。

text_en: Do not let the slanderer be established in the land; let evil speedily hunt down the violent!
text_cn: 播弄是非的人，不得在世久存， 灾祸会突然使强暴的人被擒。

text_en: I know that the Lord maintains the cause of the needy, and executes justice for the poor.
text_cn: 我确知上主必为受压迫的人伸冤， 也必为贫穷的人主持正义的判断。

text_en: Surely the righteous shall give thanks to your name; the upright shall live in your presence.
text_cn: 义人必定将你的圣名颂赞， 善人必定居住在你的面前。
